basic_profile.bio: I'm a software developer based in Berlin, balancing my love for programming and a passion for building intricate Lego structures. I enjoy exploring the intersection of Eastern and Western cultures, which often leads me to spend time on subreddits focused on Chinese culture and global perspectives. My typical online hours are in the evenings, post-work, as I like to unwind by diving into discussions about technology, Lego storage solutions, and occasionally indulging in some light-hearted humor. I work in a mid-sized tech firm, and while I'm single, I value the time spent with friends and the vibrant LGBTQ+ community in my city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Computer Science degree from a German university and have been working in software development for over five years. My expertise lies in backend development, but I have a keen interest in learning new programming languages through online courses and forums. My love for Lego has also taught me a lot about spatial design and creativity.
